paragraphs: The rocket emoji stopped meaning spaceflight almost immediately. It now means launch, growth or a share price, and it is probably the clearest example of a pictogram whose literal subject has been completely overwritten by use.
The model is extremely light at 754 polygons and 793 vertices in quads and tris with non-overlapping UVs. It carries CheckMate Lite and Pro certification.
At $24 it suits motion graphics and social content, advertising and marketing visuals, presentation and infographic work, animation, game assets and editorial illustration. On sale since 2022.
A rolled scarf is how the garment is sold rather than how it is worn. The roll shows the check, the fringe and the weight in one glance, and it stacks on a shelf in a way a folded one never will.
The model is very light at 6,880 polygons and 6,882 vertices in quads and tris with non-overlapping UVs, rolled. It carries CheckMate Lite and Pro certification.
At $24 it suits apparel and retail visualisation, e-commerce and catalogue imagery, advertising, shop and interior scenes, film set dressing and editorial illustration. On sale since 2023.
The snake plant survives being ignored, which is why it is in every office in the world. It stores water in the leaves, tolerates almost no light, and dies faster from attention than from neglect.
The model is light at 20,336 polygons and 10,244 vertices in quads and tris with non-overlapping UVs. It carries CheckMate Lite and Pro certification.
At $24 it suits interior and architectural visualisation, office and residential scenes, e-commerce and retail imagery, advertising, film sets and game environments. On sale since 2024.

A scraper is a blade held at an angle, and every variation exists because the angle matters. Paint, ice, adhesive and dough all need a different one, and using the wrong tool damages the surface rather than the deposit.
This is a collection listing rather than a single object, supplying the scrapers as static pieces. It carries CheckMate Lite and Pro certification.
At $23 the set suits tool and equipment visualisation, e-commerce and retail imagery, workshop and decorating scenes, advertising, film props and game environments. On sale since 2023.
An incubator has to turn the eggs, and that is the part people forget. A hen does it several times a day, and a machine that only holds temperature will fail because the embryo sticks to the shell.
The model is light at 28,376 polygons and 14,467 vertices in quads and tris with non-overlapping UVs, supplied with eggs. It carries CheckMate Lite and Pro certification.
At $21 it suits agricultural and education visualisation, equipment marketing, e-commerce imagery, laboratory and farm scenes, film props and editorial illustration. On sale since 2022.
A block of knives is mostly redundant on purpose. Two of them do almost all the work, and the rest exist because a set sells better than a chef's knife and a paring knife sold separately.
The model is very light at 13,062 polygons and 6,531 vertices in quads and tris with non-overlapping UVs. It carries CheckMate Lite and Pro certification.
At $21 it suits kitchen and product visualisation, e-commerce and retail imagery, advertising, interior and cooking scenes, film set dressing and editorial illustration. On sale since 2023.
The machete is an agricultural tool everywhere it is actually used, and a weapon only in imagination. The blade is thin, unhardened and meant to be sharpened in a field with whatever is available.
This is a collection listing rather than a single object, supplying the blades as static pieces. It is built to CheckMate specification, and a second volume of the set is offered separately.
At $20 it suits agricultural and outdoor visualisation, tool and equipment imagery, film and television props, game assets and editorial illustration. On sale since 2023.

The industrial jug is a shape decided by stacking and by the machine that fills it. The handle is moulded into the body rather than added, which is cheaper and also the reason it can never be replaced when it cracks.
The model is extremely light at 5,549 polygons and 5,718 vertices in quads and tris with non-overlapping UVs, textured with 4 maps all at 2048x2048. It carries CheckMate Lite and Pro certification.
At $19 it suits packaging and industrial visualisation, warehouse and workshop scenes, label mockups, e-commerce imagery, film set dressing and game environments. On sale since 2018.

Euro coins share one face across the union and give the other to each country, which makes small change a slow census of where money has travelled. The scalloped edge on this denomination exists so it can be told apart by touch.
The model holds 34,187 polygons and 34,111 vertices in quads and tris with non-overlapping UVs. It carries CheckMate Lite and Pro certification.
At $19 it suits editorial and financial illustration, numismatic and museum presentation, education material, film and television props, game assets and advertising. On sale since 2024.

Italy chose to put a different work of art on every denomination rather than a single national emblem, which makes its coins the most heavily designed in the currency. Each one is a reproduction of something in a museum.
The model holds 27,861 polygons and 27,800 vertices in quads and tris with non-overlapping UVs. It carries CheckMate Lite and Pro certification.
At $19 it suits editorial and financial illustration, numismatic and museum presentation, education material, film and television props, game assets and advertising. On sale since 2024.

A pool lilo is a piece of furniture that only works because water carries the load. On land it is uncomfortable and useless; floating, the same shape supports a person perfectly, and the design has never needed to improve.
The model holds 91,976 polygons and 45,996 vertices in quads and tris with non-overlapping UVs. It carries CheckMate Lite and Pro certification.
At $19 it suits pool and leisure visualisation, e-commerce and retail imagery, advertising, holiday and exterior scenes, film props and game environments. On sale since 2024.

An aluminium shafted paddle is the rental one. It is heavier than anything a serious paddler would choose, it survives being dropped on rocks, and that trade is exactly right for equipment used by people who have never done this before.
The model is extremely light at 868 polygons and 918 vertices in quads and tris with non-overlapping UVs. It is built to CheckMate specification.
At $19 it suits outdoor and watersport visualisation, e-commerce and retail imagery, character accessories, advertising, film props and game environments. On sale since 2024.

The unboxing is now a designed experience, and the packaging is engineered for it. Friction fits, controlled resistance and a lid that lifts slowly on trapped air are all deliberate, and none of it protects the product any better.
The model is extremely light at 1,333 polygons and 1,334 vertices in quads and tris with non-overlapping UVs, in retail packaging, and carries StemCell certification.
At $19 it suits packaging and product visualisation, e-commerce and retail imagery, unboxing and advertising work, desk scenes, film props and editorial illustration. On sale since 2024.
Bread is displayed on wood and at an angle for reasons that are entirely practical. The angle shows the crust, the wood does not sweat, and the slope means the loaves at the front sell first.
The model is light at 12,884 polygons and 13,000 vertices, built in quads only with non-overlapping UVs, textured with 4 maps at 4096x4096. It carries CheckMate Lite and Pro certification.
At $19 it suits retail and hospitality visualisation, bakery and cafe interiors, shopfitting presentation, advertising, film sets and game environments. On sale since 2016.
